3207.title: Project reads fail before provider registration settles
3207.rootCauseOneLine: Thread-inclusive project reads resolve creation defaults before the deferred provider registry has settled, so an empty startup registry produces HTTP 409.
3207.proposedFix: Await the existing registration-settled barrier in sidebar bootstrap and the thread-inclusive project-list branch before resolving project execution defaults.
3207.caveats: The server route and status transition were reproduced directly; the separate desktop rendering symptom was not re-tested.
